concepts.name: defaultdict factories
concepts.description: `defaultdict` invokes a callable factory for missing indexed keys, inserts the produced value, and returns it; `.get()` does not trigger that factory.

concepts.name: Counter and most_common
concepts.description: `Counter` counts hashable values, returns zero for missing counts, and `most_common()` orders tied counts by first encounter.

concepts.name: deque for FIFO queues
concepts.description: `deque` supports efficient appends and pops at both ends; append-right plus `popleft()` is a natural FIFO queue pattern.

concepts.name: dict.setdefault grouping
concepts.description: `dict.setdefault()` returns an existing value or inserts and returns the supplied default; the default expression is evaluated before the method call.

concepts.name: min/max with key and default
concepts.description: `min()` and `max()` use `key=` for comparison while returning the original item; the single-iterable form can use `default=` for empty input.

concepts.name: any/all with generator expressions
concepts.description: `any()` short-circuits on the first truthy value and `all()` on the first falsy value; generator expressions preserve lazy evaluation.

concepts.name: dict.get defaults
concepts.description: `dict.get()` returns a stored value or fallback without raising `KeyError`, and returning a fallback does not insert the missing key.

concepts.name: str.partition for one split
concepts.description: `str.partition()` splits at the first separator and always returns a three-tuple; an absent separator yields the original string plus two empty strings.

concepts.name: removeprefix/removesuffix
concepts.description: `removeprefix()` and `removesuffix()` remove one exact affix at the corresponding edge and differ from character-set stripping methods.

concepts.name: Set difference and intersection
concepts.description: Set operators express intersection, union, directional difference, and symmetric difference; method forms can accept general iterables where operator forms require sets.
